synopsis: A love letter to the musical classics of yesteryear, AZUL focuses on a boy who suffers an accident at the hands of his father and is transported to a dark world, ruled by an unusual presence that calls itself the 'god of death'. The young man plunges into a journey through his past where he is confronted with a battle of love, centered around his crush.
